# WhatsMyName (recorded: 2026-11-06)

- `main/wmn-data.real.json`: the real `wmn-data.json` (692 sites, 251 KB) of github.com/WebBreacher/WhatsMyName, © Micah Hoffman, **CC BY-SA 4.0** (the licence and authors are in the file's own header). Used by the parser test of `username.test.js`.
- `main/wmn-data.json`: the list the integration tests serve to the engine: 10 hand-written sites that point to `*.example` hosts of `../../../../web/` (a real site cannot be asked from a test). It is invented on purpose.
